items.question: Does Countertop replace my bookkeeper?
items.answer: No — it makes their month easier. Countertop watches operations in real time; your bookkeeper still owns the ledger. Most clients forward our accountant export straight to them.

items.question: What does setup actually involve?
items.answer: OAuth into your POS, forward one recent vendor invoice, and confirm your locations. Median time from signup to first calibrated digest is nine minutes plus one overnight backfill.

items.question: My menu changes seasonally. Will alerts go haywire?
items.answer: Thresholds recalibrate continuously against your own trailing history, and you can mark planned changes — a new menu, a holiday week — so the model expects the shift instead of flagging it.

items.question: What if I run a POS you don't support?
items.answer: Today it's Toast, Square, and Clover. Anything else, join the waitlist and we'll email when yours lands — we won't sell you an integration that doesn't exist yet.

items.question: Who sees my data?
items.answer: You and the teammates you invite. Ticket data is encrypted in transit and at rest, never sold, and never used to benchmark you against other restaurants without explicit opt-in.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: One click in settings, effective at the end of the billing month, and your data exports stay available for 90 days after. No retention calls.
